place._: The Veilfalls amphitheatre: N1 and N2 carry the two tall falls (fed by veil_west and veil_main), N3 the vines and the bridge end; E1/E2 wall the east shelf.
Side gorge (bearing 75): cascade into the pool, gorge pool and the stepped fall (G1), the rope bridge high over floor 1.
The Lowveil: a slimmer fall off the east terrace into its own pool, the escarpment dressed with low basalt cliffs.
